title: Sheep in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='57' y='74' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7a6a58'/>
  <rect x='57' y='74' width='7' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7a6a58'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='86' width='11' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2e2438'/>
  <rect x='55' y='86' width='11' height='6' rx='3' fill='#2e2438'/>

  <!-- woolly body: cluster of fluffy circles -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='22' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='62' r='12' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='62' r='12' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='48' r='12' fill='#fdfbf4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='12' fill='#fdfbf4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='13' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='56' r='8' fill='#e8e4d8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='56' r='8' fill='#e8e4d8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='14' fill='#e8e4d8'/>

  <!-- scarf around neck -->
  <path d='M33 42 Q50 52 67 42 L67 50 Q50 60 33 50 Z' fill='#e8474b'/>
  <path d='M33 42 Q50 52 67 42 L67 45 Q50 55 33 45 Z' fill='#ff6b6e'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M60 48 L66 62 L58 66 L54 52 Z' fill='#e8474b'/>
  <path d='M62 44 L67 58 L63 60 L58 46 Z' fill='#ff8588'/>

  <!-- head (face) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#3b2f2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='26' r='5' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='26' r='5' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3b2f2a' transform='rotate(-20 32 32)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='32' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3b2f2a' transform='rotate(20 68 32)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#1a1420'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='1.4' fill='#1a1420'/>
  <!-- nose & mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#8a5a4a'/>
  <path d='M50 43 Q47 46 45 44' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a3a' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 43 Q53 46 55 44' fill='none' stroke='#7a4a3a' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='3' fill='#c46a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='3' fill='#c46a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
